title: Rate-limit resilient exact-SHA parity probe for GitHub review policy activation

phases.objective: Make the existing read-only GitHub review-policy runtime parity gate tolerate transient public-probe throttling without weakening exact Production SHA, branch, migration, policy-plan, readiness-marker, or exactly-once Apply requirements.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed GitHub review policy activation workflow
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Readiness, Apply, or Verify checks auth.mad4b.com health/version/deployment-info before any policy mutation.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The three exact-SHA parity probes are serialized and transient 408/425/429/5xx responses receive bounded retry/backoff, while all unrelated fetches and all downstream governance gates retain their existing behavior.
steps: Preload the bounded public-probe fetch wrapper before the canonical live activation runner.
Serialize only GET requests to the three canonical auth.mad4b.com parity endpoints.
Retry only a finite transient HTTP status allowlist with bounded delay and attempt count.
Leave non-parity endpoints and all non-GET requests untouched.
Continue into the existing exact Production SHA, Migration 1051, policy fingerprint, readiness marker, capability envelope, and exactly-once Apply gates unchanged.
assertions: No Production deployment, database, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare, secret, or branch mutation is authorized by this patch.
The patch does not accept stale runtime SHA or relax branch equality.
The patch does not add an Apply retry and does not change ambiguous Apply reconciliation semantics.
Transient probe handling is bounded and serial, preventing a three-request burst from self-inducing a 429 loop.
Unrelated runtime and control-plane requests remain passthrough.
